eligible_rule: Every automatic_conservative target-session-scan cohort with at least five unique directly connected imaged presynaptic roots; no analyst choice among scans.
scan_inference: First average ten split replicates within scan, then average eligible scans within target; target cell is the inferential unit.
matching: Restricted route dictionaries have identical effective rank within each target-scan-split run; site shuffling preserves each selected column's values and nonzero count.
scope_boundary: A full passive conductance solve on each complete compressed reconstructed tree, using measured trial-aligned responses as a modeled prediction task. It tests task-independent anatomy-calibrated feedback sufficiency, not biological learning in vivo.
